items.evidence: Log lines 2-3: P20 aspirates 2 uL from plasmid_plate A1 and dispenses into tubes_1_5ml_1 A1.
protocol.comment 'Heat shock ... 42°C 45 s, then transfer immediately to ice 2 min' is placed after the DNA transfer and before SOC.
Log lines 12-13: P300 moves 250 uL from soc_reservoir A1 to tube A1 after the heat shock comment; the 37°C 60 min 250 rpm incubation comment follows.
Log shows P20 pick up/drop tip (lines 1, 10) and a separate P300 pick up/drop tip (lines 11, 14); no tip is held at the end.
The agent added an unrequested mix_after=(3,10), shown as three aspirate/dispense cycles in tube A1 (log lines 4-9), which pipettes the competent cells and is not part of the specified protocol.

judge.summary: The core steps (2 uL DNA, heat shock comment, 250 uL SOC, incubation comment) are correct and in order, with fresh tips dropped properly. However, the agent added an unrequested 3x mix of the competent cells after DNA addition, which deviates from the specified protocol.
